name: release-gen
description: GitHub Action wrapper for Semantic Release
author: Alexey Chekulaev <chekulaevalexey@gmail.com> (https://github.com/laxa1986)
updates-blocked: typescript 6.0.3 -> 7.x: TS 7 has no JS compiler API and typescript-eslint peer range is <6.1.0. Wait until typescript-eslint supports TS 7, then upgrade
eslint 9 -> 10: eslint-plugin-import 2.32 peer range is eslint <= 9. Wait for its support or switch to eslint-plugin-import-x (as ev-invoice did)

conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits 9.x -> 10.x: v10 needs conventional-changelog-writer 9, semantic-release 25 uses writer 8 ("Missing helper" error). Wait until semantic-release upgrades the writer
